canonical_name: Closed-Loop Metrology Inversion Engine & True Collision Avoidance
verdict_reasoning: The mathematical, algorithmic, and governance contracts for collision detection, metrology metadata binding, tool-wear inference, toolpath compensation, and closed-loop replay are fully proven with 100% mutation detection across 14 metrology and 10 collision mutations. However, physical CMM data acquisition remains SIMULATED_PHYSICAL_ACQUISITION (no live hardware CMM probe) and tool-wear inference is analytical (Usui/Taylor model) without physical cutting sensor telemetry. Under the strict SECP Engineering Truth constitution, the complete capability cannot be claimed as industrial-grade world-class without physical-world closure, mandating a final verdict of PROVEN_PARTIAL.

toolpath_inversion_and_compensation_cont.scope: Immutable CAD authority preservation, new revision proposal generation, non-mutation of canonical CAD, reversibility token, exact vector tracking

closed_loop_replay_contract.scope: Deterministic replay mathematically verified with ISO 14253-1 decision rules; physical machining simulated
